zh-Hant: 輸入很多，建議用 data = sys.stdin.read().split() 一次讀完，再用索引往下取。
不要每抽一個號碼就把整張卡重新檢查一遍。替每張卡準備計數器：rows[r]、cols[c]、diag、anti，記錄每條線已經圈了幾格。
圈起 (r, c) 時只把相關的計數器加 1，某個計數器剛好變成 N 就代表完成連線。已經連線的住戶之後可以跳過。
en: The input is large. Read it all at once with data = sys.stdin.read().split() and walk through it with an index.
Do not re-check the whole card after every draw. Give each card counters rows[r], cols[c], diag and anti that track how many cells of each line are circled.
When (r, c) is circled, add 1 to the matching counters only. A counter reaching N means a line is complete. Residents who already have a line can be skipped afterwards.
